purpose: Illustrative beauty photograph for Aesthetic Island NYC review card and case-study hero; not an actual patient or client result.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: landscape website portfolio-card background and matching case-study hero, 16:9 composition at approximately 2048x1152.
Primary request: Create an original generic medical-aesthetics beauty photograph, similar in mood to a premium skincare campaign, not a website screenshot.
Subject: One fictional adult woman around 35 with brunette hair softly swept back, calm confident expression, subtle natural makeup, healthy realistic skin with visible fine texture. Upper chest and shoulders framed tastefully, wearing a simple ivory spa wrap. One hand rests gently near her temple with relaxed anatomically natural fingers. Three-quarter portrait, eyes gently looking toward camera.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory studio background, soft beige shadows, no clutter.
Composition/framing: generous landscape framing; face and shoulders in the right two-thirds, face around 65 percent across the image; leave a calm open area on the left for existing webpage text. Keep the entire head and hand comfortably inside frame with breathing room. Portrait must remain usable in a centered 16:10 card crop and a mobile crop focused at 68 percent horizontally.
Lighting/mood: soft diffused editorial daylight, refined, welcoming, natural photographic depth, realistic skin rather than plastic retouching.
Constraints: NO text, logos, watermarks, website controls, buttons, borders, needles, procedures, before-and-after comparisons, or claims of treatment results. Do not reproduce a real client's patient or the reference model's identity. This is standalone illustrative imagery; the actual brand logo will be overlaid by the website.
